title: Test: what a post looks like
lead: This is a test post. It’s here so we can see, live, what a piece of writing looks like on the blog.
open.title: How does it open?
open.text: Clicking a row in the blog list opens the post on its own page. Its address is the post’s folder, so the link can be shared anywhere.
open.back: The Blog link on the left of the header takes you back to the main page.
open.prefs: The language and theme switches carry over whatever you picked on the main page.
open.texts: The text comes from the hu.json and en.json files in the post’s own assets/lang folder, and the language switch translates it just like the rest of the site.
image.title: An image from the post’s folder
image.caption: The image loads from the post’s own folder, like the rest of its files.
share.title: Sharing
share.text: The post’s own address is the one to share. Whoever opens it sees this same page, and the link preview comes from the post’s header:
own.title: Its own CSS and JS
own.text: A post can have its own stylesheet and script. The red subheadings and the grid below both come from this post’s own files. Try it: click the squares.
